$comment: CLI catalog — English (the only launch locale, ADR 0019). Separate from the engine's i18n/en.json because the CLI and the engine ship and translate separately (api-design.md §6). Keys are cli.*. tools/repo/i18nlint.luau checks that every key the CLI names exists here, and that no user-facing string is written at a call site (rule R3).
cli.usage:
Usage: {tool} <command> [options]

  dev [path]       run the project with a watcher attached; a saved file rebuilds the world
                   --scene=PATH starts in that scene; --scene-data=JSON is what it is handed
  edit [path]      run the project with the editor UI in place of the debug overlay
  test [path]      run the conformance suite on the headless engine
  check [path]     luau-analyze, StyLua and the i18n lint
  fmt [path]       format every Luau file with StyLua
  build-assets     compile the content directory into a pack and a manifest
  build [path]     export the game: --target=windows|linux|android|windows-server|linux-server
  keystore new     make the key an Android game is released with
  android install-tools  the JDK, Android SDK and Gradle an Android export needs
  new <name>       scaffold a project from the starter template
  setup [path]     rewrite .engine/types/ for the pinned engine, after a clone
  migrate materials [path]  scenes and stamps to material assets (ADR 0090)
  saves list|clear [path]  the saves the editor and dev made (--player: a player's; --slot=name: one)
  terrain import <source> [path]  lay the scene's terrain from a heightmap, a .luau function or hills (--size=metres)

  --help           this text
  --version        the CLI and engine versions
cli.err.unknown_command: Unknown command "{command}". Run {tool} --help for the list.
cli.err.no_command: No command given. Run {tool} --help for the list.
cli.err.no_engine: Could not find engine-host. Build the engine, or set ENG_HOST to its path.
cli.assets.err.content_outside: [assets] content = "{path}" is outside the project; the content a game ships comes from inside its own folder.
cli.assets.err.no_content: There is no content directory at {path}.
cli.assets.err.no_compiler: The asset compiler (assetc) was not found. Build it, or set ENG_ASSETC.
cli.assets.err.failed: The asset build failed; nothing was written.
cli.assets.err.not_deterministic: Two builds of the same content produced different bytes. That is a defect in the pipeline, not in the content.
cli.assets.deterministic: Verified: two builds of this content are byte-identical.
cli.migrate.err.what: Nothing called "{what}" to migrate. The one migration is: {tool} migrate materials [path].
cli.migrate.stamp_to_material: {stamp} held a Material; it is the material {material} now, and the stamp is gone.
cli.migrate.lost_reference: {file}: {name} named a material at {path} that is not in this file; the reference was dropped.
cli.migrate.nothing: Nothing to migrate in {path}: every scene and stamp is already version 2.
cli.migrate.scripts: {count} script line(s) write a .Color or a .Transparency. A part's become part:SetMaterialParameter("Color", ...) -- a light's, an emitter's and a Part2D's stay as they are:
cli.err.not_a_project: {path} is not a {brand} project: no project.toml and no src/client, src/server, src/shared or src/scenes.
cli.err.no_version: Could not read the {brand} version from {path}. {tool} runs from the engine source tree; this one has no project() declaration to read.
cli.err.no_lute_version: {path} did not report a version, so the Lute half of --version has nothing to show.
cli.dev.watching: Watching {count} director(ies) under {path}. Save a file to reload.
cli.dev.listening: Dev server on ws://127.0.0.1:{port}. Waiting for the engine to attach.
cli.dev.reloaded: Reloaded in {ms} ms — {scripts} script(s), {preserved} instance(s) preserved.
cli.dev.reload_failed: Reload refused; the previous world is still running. {detail}
cli.dev.reload_slow: Reloaded in {ms} ms, over the {budget} ms budget ADR 0024 sets.
cli.dev.warn.no_debug_ui: {path} was built without the debug UI, so F3, the inspector and the REPL are not in it. Build the dev preset, or set ENG_HOST.
cli.dev.err.no_scripts: {path} mounts no scripts, so there would be nothing to reload. A project mounts the .luau files under src/client, src/server, src/shared and src/scenes/<scene>/.
cli.dev.err.port_in_use: Port {port} is already in use. Set [dev] port in project.toml, or stop whatever is holding it.
cli.edit.err.no_editor_host: {path} was built without the debug UI, so it has no editor in it -- opening it would give you an empty window. Build the dev or editor preset, or set ENG_HOST to a host that has one.
cli.test.err.no_report: The engine wrote no report at {path}, so nothing was measured. An empty suite passes forever.
cli.test.err.no_cases: The suite at {path} contains no cases. An empty suite passes forever.
cli.check.sides_skipped: check: no engine is built here, so where each script runs was not checked.
cli.check.ok_warnings: check: ok — {count} file(s), no errors, {warnings} warning(s) above.
cli.check.editor_skipped: check: no engine is built here, so the scripts were not checked as the editor checks them.
cli.check.editor_no_checker: check: the engine found here has no script checker (a player build, or an older engine), so the scripts were not checked as the editor checks them.
cli.check.err.editor: The editor's checker reported {count} error(s): the lines above, which a script's tab in the editor shows too.
cli.check.err.editor_failed: The scripts could not be checked as the editor checks them: {message}
cli.check.err.stylua: StyLua reported unformatted files. Run {tool} fmt.
cli.check.err.i18n: The game's catalogs are not complete: every key of the default locale must be in every other.
cli.check.err.catalog_missing: i18n/{locale}.json has no "{key}", which the default locale has.
cli.check.err.catalog_unreadable: {file} is not a catalog: it must be one JSON object of key to text.
cli.check.catalog_extra: i18n/{locale}.json has "{key}", which the default locale does not: nothing asks for it.
cli.check.err.missing_tool: {program} was not found: this {brand} installation carries none in tools/bin, and there is none on PATH. Reinstall {brand}, or put {program} on PATH.
cli.check.stylua_skipped: The formatting was not checked: StyLua is not installed. {tool} fmt says how to get it.
cli.fmt.err.no_stylua: StyLua is not installed, and it is what formats a project. Download it from https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/releases and put stylua on PATH, or in this installation's tools/bin folder.
cli.build.done: Built {path}, and {archive} beside it. Run {executable} inside the folder; the whole folder is the product.
cli.build.icon: The artifact carries the icon from {path}, read back out of it to be sure.
cli.build.err.no_engine_content: The engine has no content directory at {path}; a build without it would ship a player that cannot load its own message catalog.
cli.build.warn.no_partition: The scene could not be partitioned into streaming cells, so the game will partition it the first time it runs.
cli.build.warn.dev_host: --dev-host: packaging {path}, which is not the player profile. The artifact carries the debug overlay, the inspector and a Luau REPL against its own VM. Do not release it.
cli.build.err.output_exists: {path} already exists and was not written by {tool} build. Pass --force to clear it, or choose another --output.
cli.build.err.icon_failed: The icon at {path} could not be put into the artifact, so the game would have shipped wearing the engine's face.
cli.build.warn.no_iconpatch: iconpatch was not found, so the artifact keeps the engine's icon. Build it, or set ENG_ICONPATCH.
cli.build.done_android: Built {path}. Install it with adb install -r, or from the editor's Export window.
cli.build.step.partition: Partitioning the world into streaming cells
cli.build.step.seal: Sealing the game into its pack
cli.build.err.seal_failed: The game was not sealed by {compiler}. If that asset compiler is older than this command it has no `seal`: build it again, or name another with ENG_ASSETC.
cli.build.err.no_sealer: There is no asset compiler on this machine to seal the game with. Build it (`assetc`), or set [export] packed = false to ship the game as loose files.
cli.build.step.layout: Copying the player and the game
cli.build.step.stamp: Stamping the icon and the version
cli.build.err.progress_format: --progress={format} is not a format; the one there is is --progress=json.
cli.check.types_refreshed: This project's engine types were from another engine; written again from this one.
cli.build.err.mesh_format: The asset compiler at {compiler} writes mesh format {format}, and the player at {player} cannot read it: they come from different builds. Build the player and the tools together, or point ENG_ASSETC at the compiler of the player's build.
cli.build.err.no_player: There is no player for {target}. An installation keeps one under player/; a build of this repository makes it with the {preset} preset; or point {variable} at one. Pass --dev-host to package this machine's development host instead, which carries the debug overlay, the inspector and a Luau REPL.
cli.build.err.no_script_compiler: There is no engine on this machine to compile the scripts with. Build the player or the dev host, or set [export] ship_source = true to ship the source.
cli.build.err.multiplayer_mode: [export] multiplayer = "{mode}" is not a mode. It is none, host or dedicated.
cli.build.err.server_needs_dedicated: {target} is a dedicated server's package, and this game is not dedicated. Set [export] multiplayer = "dedicated" in project.toml.
cli.build.err.version_failed: The version could not be stamped into the executable.
cli.build.err.android_no_jdk: No JDK 17 was found. Set JAVA_HOME, or run {tool} android install-tools, which installs it into your {brand} folder.
cli.build.err.android_no_gradle: No Gradle was found under the {brand} toolchains folder. Run {tool} android install-tools, which installs it into your {brand} folder.
cli.build.err.android_no_sdk: No Android SDK was found. Set ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, or run {tool} android install-tools, which installs it into your {brand} folder.
cli.build.err.android_no_template: The Android project template (platforms/android/player) is not in this installation.
cli.build.err.android_no_shaders: No SPIR-V shaders were found for the Android player: neither beside it nor in a desktop build of the engine.
cli.build.err.android_package: "{package}" is not an Android package name. It is reverse-DNS, like com.studio.game: at least two parts, each starting with a letter.
cli.build.err.android_version_code: [export.android] version_code = {code}: it has to be a whole number of at least 1.
cli.build.err.android_keystore: The debug key could not be made at {path}.
cli.build.err.android_gradle: Gradle could not assemble the APK. Its output is above.
cli.build.err.android_no_apksigner: The SDK's apksigner is not at {path}. Install build-tools 35.0.0.
cli.build.err.android_permission_value: [export.android] {name} must be true or false. Leave it out and it is declared when the project's scripts use what needs it.
cli.build.err.android_manifest: The Android template's manifest at {path} is missing, or has lost the marks its permissions are written between.
cli.build.warn.android_no_internet: [export.android] internet = false, and the project's scripts use the network: on a phone every socket will be refused, so nothing will join, host or fetch.
cli.build.warn.android_no_vibrate: [export.android] vibrate = false, and the project's scripts use HapticService: the phone will not vibrate.
cli.build.err.android_pages: {library} is laid out for pages of {found} bytes. A phone with 16 KB pages (Android 15 and later) cannot load it, and a store refuses an app that carries it: the library must be linked with -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384.
cli.build.err.android_library_unread: {library} could not be read as a native library ({why}), so whether it loads on a phone with 16 KB pages is not known.
cli.build.elf.not_elf: it is not an ELF file
cli.build.err.android_no_library: {path} carries no native library: the engine's own is missing from it.
cli.build.err.android_release_key: [export.android] release = true needs keystore and key_alias: the key the game is released with. {tool} keystore new makes one.
cli.build.err.android_no_keystore: The release keystore {path} does not exist.
cli.build.err.android_no_password: No password for {path}. Set ENG_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD (and ENG_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD if the key's differs), or remember it on this machine from the editor's Export window. It never goes in project.toml.
cli.keystore.err.usage:
Usage: {tool} keystore new --alias <name> --out <file> [--name <who>] [--validity <years>] [--remember]
       {tool} keystore remember --out <file>

The password comes from ENG_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, never from the command line.
cli.keystore.err.exists: {path} already exists, and a keystore is never replaced: a game signed with it could never be updated again.
cli.keystore.err.no_password: Set ENG_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD to the keystore's password, six characters or more. It is read from the environment so that it is on no command line.
cli.keystore.remembered: The passwords are remembered on this machine, outside the project.
cli.keystore.warn.keep_it: Keep this file and its password safe, and back them up. A store accepts an update only when it is signed with the same key: lose either, and the game can never be updated again.
cli.android.done: The Android tools are in {folder}, and the SDK in {sdk}. {tool} build --target=android finds them there.
cli.android.err.checksum: {url} did not download as the archive this version pins (SHA-256 {found}, expected {expected}); it was not installed.
cli.android.err.download: Could not download {url}. Is this machine online?
cli.android.err.no_unzip: Nothing here opens a .zip: install unzip, and run this again.
cli.android.err.package: The SDK package {package} was not installed. Were its licences refused?
cli.new.err.unknown_template: No template named "{name}". The v1 template is "starter".
cli.new.err.bad_name: "{name}" is not a usable project name: use letters, digits, dashes and underscores.
cli.new.err.no_install: Cannot find the {brand} installation this CLI belongs to: nothing above this script holds a templates directory.
cli.setup.err.not_a_project: There is no project.toml here, so this is not a {brand} project.
cli.setup.err.nothing_to_write: Found no types to write. Is the engine installation complete?
cli.saves.no_folder: The project names no game ([project] name or id), so there is no player folder to look in.
cli.saves.unknown_action: "{action}" is not something saves does: list or clear.
cli.terrain.err.usage:
Usage: {tool} terrain import <source> [path] --size=<metres> [--low=<m>] [--high=<m>] [--material=<id>]

  <source> is a heightmap (a 16-bit PNG, a RAW, or a folder of tiles named <anything>_x<column>_y<row>),
  a .luau file that returns function(x, z) answering a height, or the word hills (--seed, --scale, --octaves).
cli.terrain.err.no_source: There is nothing at {source} to import.
cli.terrain.err.no_size: Say how wide the terrain is: --size=<metres>.
cli.toml.err.unsupported_value: not a value this reader supports: {token}
cli.toml.err.arrays_of_tables: arrays of tables are not supported in project.toml
cli.json.err.key_not_a_string: a key that is not a string
